acceptance_predicates.description: Production discover, preflight, quiesce, stage, validate, reopen, and recovery handlers consume live typed evidence.
UpgradeEngine receives only immutable live bindings and generated operations from the production command boundary.
Phase failure and process death leave durable failed or safe-mode state without false success.

definition_of_done: Git and SQLite production phase adapters pass hostile and process-death tests.
Exact-head independent review, hosted checks, post-merge verification, and reconciliation pass.
No source-to-model refinement proof or authorization prerequisite is required.

inputs.description: Existing UpgradeEngine phase and journal contracts.

outputs.description: Production phase-to-engine orchestration for supported operations.

gates.description: Every phase uses current durable state and concrete authority evidence.
Ambiguous phase outcomes are durable and non-retryable.
A distinct reviewer checks the exact candidate head.
